name: sumo-qa-eval-tooling
description: Node dev tooling for the sumo-qa promptfoo eval harness. Not published; the Python package is in pyproject.toml.

scripts.eval:all: for f in tests/evals/promptfoo/skill-*.yaml; do case "$f" in *.gen.yaml) continue;; esac; promptfoo eval -c "$f" --no-cache; done
